title: Grateful Dead Live at The Omni on 1991-04-05
source: flac16/48kHz; DAT sound board master recorded by Dan Healy; DAT x Zero-Cassette x Zero Transfer By Dan Healy using his custom built multi cassette cloning machine nicknamed "The "Gorgon"; Analog Cassette (via Dick Latvala) to DAT Digital-Nakamichi Dragon-Sony PCM R-500 DAT@ 48KHz (circa 1998); DAT play back on a Sony PCM R-500-Digital Audio Labs Card deluxe-WAV; Editing(Adobe Audition 3.0)-FLAC encoding(dBpoweramp); Tagging(Tag & Re-name) Jim Wise

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture with quad‑PA immersion, highlighted by stellar Other One, Stir It Up, Shakedown Street and Space Jam performances.
ai_review.review: The recording delivers an epic, four‑channel sound that makes the Healy PA stacks feel like they’re surrounding you, providing crystal‑clear clarity throughout. Musically the show is a pinnacle of the tour, with The Other One, Stir It Up, Shakedown Street and the Space jam all described as out‑of‑this‑world moments.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviewers praise the performance and the quad sound quality, indicating an outstanding show and excellent recording; however only two reviews (one non‑informative) limit confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Quad PA stacks captured from the taper section create immersive, crystal‑clear sound with no reported issues; reviewers note the audio bouncing around corners in a spectacular way.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewed as the tour's pinnacle with a high‑energy flow; standout jams and songs keep the momentum strong throughout.
